strings.text: The youngest band runs on an **earlier calendar** than everyone else. strings.text: The two youngest grades are split by birthday. A child turning five **by October 16** of the school year applied for is eligible for **Kindergarten (K5)**. A child turning five **on or before April 16** is eligible for **Transitional Kindergarten (TK)**. The school describes TK as a bridge between preschool and kindergarten that gives a child time to build the basic skills kindergarten expects. The birthday is not the whole decision; see the readiness screening below. TK is the earliest K–12 entry point. Younger children are enrolled through the **Early Education Center** office, not through this process.
strings.t: De pi piti klas yo separe selon dat fèt. Yon timoun k ap fè senkan **anvan 16 oktòb** ane eskolè a ou ap aplike pou a kalifye pou **Kindergarten (K5)**. Yon timoun k ap fè senkan **16 avril oswa anvan** kalifye pou **Transitional Kindergarten (TK)**. Lekòl la dekri TK kòm yon pon ant preskolè ak kindergarten, ki bay yon timoun tan pou l devlope konpetans debaz kindergarten mande yo. Dat fèt la pa tout desizyon an; gade egzamen preparasyon an anba a. TK se pi bonè kote yon timoun ka antre nan K–12. Timoun ki pi piti enskri atravè biwo **Early Education Center** an, pa atravè pwosesis sa a.

strings.text: Three forms complete a TK or K5 file. The first is an **Information form**. The second is a **Readiness Checklist**, completed by your child's preschool or daycare teacher. The third is a **Personal Recommendation form from your family's pastor**, which is required at every grade from TK through 12. Send all three promptly. strings.text: Your child takes a **developmentally appropriate skills assessment** during the admissions process. Qualifying for the program depends on passing it. Along with the birthday cutoffs, the assessment settles whether your child is placed in TK or K5. Testing is arranged through the **Student Services office**, and it is scheduled **only after the admissions office has received all of the required forms**. strings.text: This is the band where the paperwork jumps. **Four recommendation forms** are required. strings.text: The final decision is **communicated in writing**. It weighs satisfactory grades, the letters of recommendation, the interview, behavior reports and entrance testing. strings.text: Admission rests on four things the school lists together. The first is an **online interview with the Director of the International Student Program and the Principal**. The others are the completed online application, prior academic and behavioral performance, and the English-test scores. The interview is held online, so it **replaces the campus visit** that opens every domestic band. A family applying from abroad is not expected to travel first. Hickory Grove has run its international program since **2013**. It issues its own I-20 (the form a student needs to apply for a student visa) rather than routing families through a third party.

Hickory Grove gen pwogram entènasyonal li depi **2013**. Li bay pwòp I-20 pa l (fòm yon elèv bezwen pou l aplike pou yon viza etidyan) olye l voye fanmi yo bay yon lòt moun.

It also needs the **high school transcript and the previous two years of report cards, both translated into English**. Include any accommodations plan, educational evaluation or medical diagnosis that applies. The application fee is **non-refundable** and **due at the time of application**. But its **amount is not published**, so ask the international office.

Li bezwen tou **relve nòt lekòl segondè a ak bilten de ane anvan yo, toude tradui an anglè**. Mete nenpòt plan aranjman, evalyasyon edikatif oswa dyagnostik medikal ki aplike. strings.text: The program covers an **orientation before school starts**, **PSAT and ACT testing** and **weekly meetings with the International Student Director**. strings.text: Aid runs through **FACTS Grant & Aid Assessment**, and **FACTS charges $40** to process the application. Request the aid information from the **finance office** at finance@hgchristian.org. Do things in this order. First, apply for, accept or renew the **NC Opportunity Scholarship** through the state education assistance authority. **Anyone can apply**: there is no income cap on applying, and applications open **February 1**. Then, if you are still waiting on that scholarship or it will not meet your need, apply to Hickory Grove for aid. That aid is awarded "until all available funds have been allocated". **ESA+** is available for children with disabilities attending an eligible non-public school. Hickory Grove's own aid application can be submitted **only once your HGCS application is complete**. A new federal **Education Freedom Tax Credit** funds K–12 scholarships from January 1, 2027, through an approved Scholarship Granting Organization. Families apply to that organization, not the school, and Hickory Grove has not yet named its partner. Hickory Grove offers **no automatic discounts**, such as multi-child or pastor discounts. But families earn a **5% discount for paying the whole school year's tuition by May 31**.
strings.t: Èd la pase pa **FACTS Grant & Aid Assessment**, epi **FACTS mande $40** pou trete aplikasyon an. Mande enfòmasyon sou èd la nan **biwo finans** lan nan finance@hgchristian.org. Fè bagay yo nan lòd sa a. Anvan, aplike, aksepte oswa renouvle **NC Opportunity Scholarship** la atravè otorite eta a pou asistans edikasyon. **Nenpòt moun ka aplike**: pa gen limit revni pou aplike, epi aplikasyon yo louvri **1ye fevriye**. Apre sa, si w toujou ap tann bous sa a, oswa si li p ap kouvri bezwen w, aplike pou èd nan Hickory Grove. Yo bay èd sa a "jiskaske tout lajan ki disponib fin distribye". **ESA+** disponib pou timoun ki gen andikap k ap ale nan yon lekòl ki pa piblik ki kalifye. Ou ka soumèt pwòp aplikasyon èd Hickory Grove a **sèlman lè aplikasyon HGCS ou a fin konplè**. Yon nouvo **Education Freedom Tax Credit** federal finanse bous K–12 apati 1ye janvye 2027, atravè yon Scholarship Granting Organization ki apwouve. Fanmi yo aplike nan òganizasyon sa a, pa nan lekòl la, epi Hickory Grove poko nonmen patnè li. Hickory Grove **pa ofri okenn rabè otomatik**, tankou rabè pou plizyè timoun oswa pou pastè. Men fanmi yo jwenn yon **rabè 5% si yo peye frè eskolarite tout ane lekòl la anvan 31 me**.
